name: potion-ability-vapor
description: Debug Wizards lose attributes to sickness, then inhale uncursed and blessed restore-ability vapor from potions shattered on the floor. The uncursed vapor restores the sole deficit; the blessed vapor scans all six attributes and raises each deficit once.
